title: Reuse CrossPlaneBinding identity during Fourfold canonicalization
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: FourfoldSnapshot canonicalization recomputed each CrossPlaneBinding semantic key twice and each canonical digest four times: duplicate check, digest-index insertion, canonical sort key, and provenance-input reconstruction. Binding digests serialize and hash immutable canonical payloads, so this repeated work was redundant inside one bounded constructor.
primary_claim: Each validated CrossPlaneBinding semantic key and digest is now computed once during FourfoldSnapshot canonicalization. The retained digest key supplies duplicate rejection, deterministic digest ordering, canonical binding order, and provenance inputs without rehashing the same immutable binding. Endpoint membership, semantic-claim uniqueness, duplicate refusal, provenance requirements, Forest authority, Fourfold semantics, and promotion authority are unchanged.
gardener_decision: Reuse constructor-local semantic keys and canonical digest strings instead of repeatedly serializing/hashing immutable CrossPlaneBinding records or introducing a persistent cache. Keep one existing digest-index as the authority for duplicate refusal, canonical binding ordering and provenance input reconstruction.
